title: Recall Status
description: Open recall status for a vehicle, sourced exclusively from the OEM recall database. Produced by maintenance-vehicle-health-ingestion and consumed by risk-scoring-engine.

vehicle_id.description: Identifier of the vehicle whose recall status is reported.

has_open_recall.description: True if the vehicle currently has at least one open, unresolved manufacturer recall.

recall_count.description: Total number of open recalls against this vehicle.

description.description: Human-readable summary of the recall scope and risk.

issued_date.description: ISO-8601 date on which the recall was officially issued.

recall_details.description: Ordered list of open recall records. Empty array when has_open_recall is false.

source.description: Identifies that this record originates exclusively from the OEM recall database.

checked_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of when the OEM recall database was last queried for this vehicle.
